blocklens.title: BlockLens
blocklens.capability.anvil.description: Show which direction an anvil faces.
blocklens.capability.beehive.description: Show which direction a beehive faces.
blocklens.capability.fence_gate.descript: Show fence gate orientation and state.
blocklens.capability.froglight.descripti: Show the axis of a froglight.
blocklens.capability.stainedglass.descri: Improve the visibility of stained glass.
blocklens.capability.stairs.description: Show stair facing, half and shape.
blocklens.capability.wood.description: Show the axis of wood blocks.
blocklens.capability.blueice.description: Add a visibility cue to blue ice.
blocklens.capability.deadcoral.descripti: Add visibility cues to dead coral.
blocklens.capability.powdersnow.descript: Make powder snow easier to identify.
blocklens.capability.sculk_catalyst.desc: Make sculk catalysts easier to identify.
blocklens.capability.nethertweaks.descri: Adjust visual cues for Nether blocks.
blocklens.capability.stringtweaks.descri: Make tripwire and tripwire hooks easier to see.
blocklens.settings.saved_error: Save failed. Retry or discard changes.
blocklens.capability.glass_highlight.des: Add bright cyan cues to glass and amber cues to glass panes.
blocklens.capability.kelp_highlight.desc: Add animated magenta and orange ribbons to kelp.
blocklens.capability.bright_concrete.des: Light white concrete while keeping the active resource-pack model.
blocklens.capability.low_fire.descriptio: Reduce only the first-person fire overlay; choose its size in Details.
blocklens.capability.handheld_size.descr: Scale first-person item models independently for blocks, items and tools.
blocklens.capability.bright_chest.descri: Give regular chests a bright white appearance; other materials stay unchanged.
blocklens.comfort.draft_hint: Changes apply when saved on the main settings screen.
blocklens.capability.debris_analyzer.des: Occluded frames for loaded ancient debris in a bounded sphere. Dense scans take several ticks; ordering uses the pass start viewpoint.
blocklens.capability.lava_analyzer.descr: Loaded source lava with a known non-source neighbor. Bounded scanning skips unavailable chunks.
blocklens.capability.beacon_range.descri: Horizontal square for completed beacon base layers. Does not infer beam clearance or active effects.
blocklens.capability.lightning_rod_range: Horizontal 128-block square and target frame. Does not predict lightning or follow terrain.
blocklens.capability.villager_job_site_l: Links actual client job-site memories to loaded nearby sites. Vanilla often lacks this memory; dense samples may omit villagers.
blocklens.capability.block_filter.descri: Hide selected block models and block entities. Fluids, collisions and solid occlusion remain. Empty allow lists hide all models.
blocklens.capability.entity_filter.descr: Hide selected world entity types, retaining your own player. Empty allow lists hide all other types. Server state is unchanged.
blocklens.scene.hint: Use list before leaving. Only main Save and Apply persists edits. An empty allow list hides all types except your player.
blocklens.scene.invalid: Use registered namespaced IDs. Maximum 512 per list, 256 characters per ID and 48 KiB across all lists. The draft was retained.
blocklens.scene.applied: Valid rules are in the draft. Save and Apply on the main screen to persist them. OFF restores normal rendering.
